project_list.name: Component development for CMS
project_list.description: Designed and developed a library of reusable frontend components that could be configured and combined by content editors through the CMS. Components were built with responsive behavior, reusable styling and flexible content structures in mind, allowing the same patterns to support multiple page layouts.

project_list.name: Formula 1® Grand Prix España 2026
project_list.description: Landing page developed for a major international event in Spain. Built pixel-perfect interfaces based on Figma prototypes provided by the creative team, collaborating closely with multiple teams and leading the landing page development to ensure quality, consistency, and timely delivery.

project_list.name: Recipe Saver
project_list.description: App to save your favorite recipes, add new ones and categorize them. Built with NextJS and Firebase for backend.

project_list.name: Daniel Śnieżyński web
project_list.description: Freelance website created for a local business offering custom furniture and wooden terrace services. Designed and developed a bespoke, lightweight page using Vanilla JavaScript and Tailwind CSS, working directly with the client to deliver a tailored solution and deploying the final site to a custom domain via Netlify.
